source_scope: Generic benchmark topology with competition landing-page reference; no historical winning implementation identified.
implementation_choices: Private integer day ordinals and explicit boundaries define periods. Caller supplies a fixed active store-item/category population; missing observed-period transactions mean zero. Final-period targets are unobserved NaN.

Net quantities sum before clipping to [0,20], retaining negative returns within aggregation. Lags, full-width shifted rolling means and entity/store/item/category/global expanding means use prior clipped targets only.

Explicit cold-start mean and periodic sin/cos controls. No inferred holidays, promotions, source calendar parsing or embeddings. These are alternatives/examples in the generic intake, not a historical winner recipe.
LightGBM squared-error training uses native categorical entity slots. Validation metric and final forecasts clip predictions to [0,20]. No XGBoost or optional ensemble blend is implemented.

Explicit bounded TPE search includes trials beyond random startup; model-based sampler path verified. Early stopping uses rolling one-step validation; final model refits all observed rows from selected start with the selected iteration count.

Validation features may use earlier validation-period observations. This is not fixed-origin multi-period forecasting, and the hyperparameter-selection score is not an unbiased held-out performance estimate.

Optuna verbosity is temporarily suppressed and restored to avoid emitting private objective metrics; LightGBM logging is disabled. Dedicated process isolation remains preferable for concurrent callers.

Published graph candidate executes numerical training in a fresh same-environment process after the in-process graph segfaulted. Direct and isolated results match; exact native crash cause is unestablished.
